messages:
alex: Heads-up — we just got an incident spike in eu-west (ingress 503s). Deploybot paused today's 13:00 slot automatically. Can we confirm an emergency hold and quick plan?

deploy-bot: [automated] deploybot paused release slot 2026-02-14T13:00Z due to service.edge ingress 503 rate > configured-threshold. Paused slots: 13:00-13:30. Trigger: observed circuit flapping on frontends.

priya: Confirming hold. Agree no new rollouts until we stabilize. Proposal: pin canary to v2.14.2 (previous known-good) and reserve slot for emergency hotfixes only.

dmitri: Observed KV-cache invalidation and a kernel flag `mesh-kv-optim` flip in the last runtime rollout. Symptoms line up with increased 503s under headroom pressure. Recommend rollback of that flag for canaries.

sarah: Ops on it — we can rollback the flag and re-run health checks. ETA ~20m. I'll also prepare a short customer comms note marking degraded ingress and that we're pausing releases. :loudspeaker: 

alex: Quick decision tree: 1) hold confirmed 2) pin canary to v2.14.2 (priya) 3) ops rollback `mesh-kv-optim` (dmitri) 4) reschedule the paused slot to a staggered window at 16:00 UTC with 5m cadence to reduce blast radius (alex) 5) update release notes & postmortem link (priya/sarah). Anyone object?

priya: No objections. Running pin now: `rls pin --slot 13:00 --version v2.14.2 --reason "incident hold - ingress 503"`

ops-oncall: Oncall here — I'll watch the error-rate and infra alarms. If rate doesn't fall within 30m we escalate to infra and consider circuit isolates.

dmitri: Starting rollback: `sudo /opt/runtime/bin/ctrl rollback-flag mesh-kv-optim` — output: "flag unset, restarting runtime on canary nodes". Monitoring logs for kv-error spikes.

sarah: Drafted customer blurb, short and clear: "We're experiencing increased 503s in EU-West. We've paused releases and rolled back a runtime flag to stabilize. We're monitoring and will update in 30m or on resolution." Putting it in #ops-status and support template.

deploy-bot: slot 13:00 remains paused. New tentative slot created: 2026-02-14T16:00Z with staggered cadence 5m; canary group first. Backfill policy: allow only non-breaking low-risk patches and emergency hotfixes.

alex: Nice. Action owners recap: priya = pin & update release notes/postmortem placeholder; dmitri = rollback & verify metrics; sarah = customer comms + support note; ops-oncall = monitor/escalate. I'll schedule a 25m check-in here.

priya: Added postmortem stub in docs and linked the incident ticket. `rls note --slot 13:00 --add "paused due to ingress spike; pinned to v2.14.2"` :white_check_mark:

dmitri: Runtime rollback completed on canaries; metrics trending — error-rate down ~45% in the last 3m. Continuing to watch KV hit-rate and latency.

sarah: Sent customer comms to affected cohort (EU customers) via support template. Included ETA note and how-to contact support.

ops-oncall: No new infra alerts. Error-rate down but still above baseline; holding watch for 30m before clearing.

alex: Thanks team. If things stay stable, we'll keep the emergency pin and re-run a controlled canary at 16:00 with stagger. If any blocker shows up, we revert to rollback plan (full rollback of last runtime rollout). Reopen this thread with any new blockers.

priya: A reminder — update release notes and changelog to mark the paused deploy and the pinned version so downstream teams don't accidentally requeue it.

dmitri: Noted. Leaving monitoring hooks on and will publish trace link once available.

sarah: I'll post a short follow-up to #customer-comms after 30m with status.

alex: Reconvene in ~25m here. Thanks all.
